title: Player Weapon Classes
doc: Slice toggle. Off: Slices.VerdictForOverlay skips every file below before
it is opened, so none of its rows reach RulePlan. These files are loaded
by the row-edit engine, so they also have no effect while [Slices]
ModelRules is off (ModelRules.Init returns before Overlays.Load).
One row per player weapon class: ten of the sixteen WeaponClass values.
GearClasses.ExcludedClasses leaves out 7 (a single row, so a class
lever would be that row), 9, 18 and 19 (drones), and 16 and 17 (tuned
item by item in cyberweapons-claws.csv and cyberweapons-lasers.csv).
uiDoc: Turn this off and the mod skips this page's files, so nothing on this page is applied.

fields.label: Enable Player Weapon Classes
fields.doc: On applies this slice's files; off skips them before they are opened. Default true. Lever sheet, not a direct overlay: the first column is WeaponClass, a class id rather than a row id, and there is no game table called "gear-classes". GearClasses.cs expands each row at load into one rule with a WeaponClass selector and an enemy-id exclusion set. The lever columns are WeaponModel column names, which makes the file look like a direct overlay; the row is what differs. The levers are the suffixed columns (BallisticDamage1, not BallisticDamage), because the unsuffixed names are aliases whose writes the game discards.
